definitions.gloss: sleep deprivation; lack of sleep; insufficient sleep
definitions.explanation: a condition of not getting enough sleep

examples.japanese: {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}で{頭|あたま}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: I have a headache from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}が{続|つづ}くと、{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}しやすくなる。
examples.english: If sleep deprivation continues, you become prone to falling ill.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{慢性的|まんせいてき}な{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}に{悩|なや}まされている。
examples.english: He suffers from chronic sleep deprivation.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{睡眠|すいみん} (sleep) + {不足|ぶそく} (insufficiency/shortage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}する - to remedy sleep deprivation
- {睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく}が{続|つづ}く - sleep deprivation continues
- {慢性的|まんせいてき}な{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく} - chronic sleep deprivation

HEALTH EFFECTS:
Prolonged sleep deprivation can lead to:
- {集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}の{低下|ていか} (decreased concentration)
- {免疫力|めんえきりょく}の{低下|ていか} (weakened immune system)
- {生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}のリスク{増加|ぞうか} (increased risk of lifestyle diseases)

RELATED WORDS:
- {寝不足|ねぶそく} - more casual way to say "lack of sleep"
- {不眠症|ふみんしょう} - insomnia (medical condition)
